replies.body: DrCrAftHD has been punished, although JaimeMcPlayer was not, due to the fact that Axis has fence posts, which can result in a 1.7 visual glitch/NoSlowDown glitch with bows and swords, in this case it was not certain if he was glitched or not. Thanks for reporting!
